implemented_strengths: Persistent K table family and Alembic migration exist.
Product CRUD and manual keyword/risk/media metadata backend endpoints exist.
Some provider-gated endpoints perform real HTTP calls through server-side API key injection.
Module manifest, frontend navigation, adapter registry, dependency bindings, execution gate, API key system, and workflow registry entries exist.
production_blockers: No complete business closed loop from product creation to P/GMC/SEO export.
AI outputs are not normalized into canonical K product fields.
SERP output does not persist keyword candidates.
AI keyword optimization is not implemented.
Image/media management is metadata-only in backend and absent in UI.
P/GMC/SEO output is workflow metadata only, without runtime dispatch/export UI.
High-risk approval and operation-log requirements are declared but not enforced/written in K runtime.
UI lacks product edit/review/archive/export and DeepSeek/risk-filter controls.
Direct K endpoint tests for provider and business flow behavior were not found.

k_series_blocking_gaps_list.title: No product-to-export business closed loop
k_series_blocking_gaps_list.detail: The implemented pieces do not form product creation -> AI generation -> SERP analysis -> risk review -> save -> P/GMC/SEO export.

k_series_blocking_gaps_list.title: DeepSeek output is not canonicalized
k_series_blocking_gaps_list.detail: DeepSeek provider output is stored as JSON/event data but not merged into product fields, attributes, keywords, category, SEO, GMC, or review items.

k_series_blocking_gaps_list.title: SERP keywords are not persisted
k_series_blocking_gaps_list.detail: SERP search can return keywords but does not create k_product_knowledge_keywords records.

k_series_blocking_gaps_list.title: P/GMC/SEO export is metadata only
k_series_blocking_gaps_list.detail: Workflow registry records exist, but there is no K export endpoint, UI action, n8n dispatch, or output artifact.

k_series_blocking_gaps_list.title: AI keyword optimization missing
k_series_blocking_gaps_list.detail: No K17/K18-style AI keyword ranking/filtering pipeline is implemented.

k_series_blocking_gaps_list.title: Unit conversion missing
k_series_blocking_gaps_list.detail: Only unit-related fields exist; no conversion service, endpoint, UI, or downstream normalized unit output exists.

k_series_blocking_gaps_list.title: Image system incomplete
k_series_blocking_gaps_list.detail: Backend supports media metadata only; no upload/storage/review/selection UI or runtime image handling exists.

k_series_blocking_gaps_list.title: Execution contracts and runtime behavior mismatch
k_series_blocking_gaps_list.detail: Adapter actions declare no_op, provider contracts are executable=false, but K router performs direct provider HTTP calls.

k_series_blocking_gaps_list.title: High-risk approval and operation logs not enforced
k_series_blocking_gaps_list.detail: Risk filtering and risk term management are declared high-risk/approval/log-required, but endpoint code does not enforce approval or write operation logs.

k_series_blocking_gaps_list.title: K UI is not workflow-complete
k_series_blocking_gaps_list.detail: The UI lacks product edit/review/archive/export, media management, DeepSeek enrichment, translation, risk-filter triggers, and selected-product context wiring.
